items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Did you ever hear Mac Murray on the streets?

ctx.x: Black Benny. People think that Black Benny was the best bass drum player they had on the street. But me, I liked it in the Orange Trepan. He's a better time keeper. And Benny had that way of clowning on the streets and making a lot of motions. That wasn't the people. He'd be playing too. They had nice drums. If I had to pick between the two I think it would be Trepanion. He's the best drummer. When he set that time, the time stood there.
Did you ever hear Mac Murray on the streets?
